units.source_text: 当地贵公子等闻得常陆守有许多女儿，来信求婚者甚多。

en.t: When the young noblemen of the area heard that the Governor of Hitachi had many daughters, many of them sent letters asking for marriage.

units.source_text: 前夫人所生二三位小姐，都已选定相当女婿，婚嫁完毕。

en.t: The two or three young ladies born to his former wife had all been matched with suitable husbands, and their marriages had already been completed.

units.source_text: 现在中将君也想替这前夫所生的女儿找一个如意称心的女婿。

en.t: Now Chujo no Kimi also wanted to find a pleasing and suitable husband for this daughter born to her former husband.

units.source_text: 她朝夕照管浮舟，对她无限疼爱。

en.t: She looked after Ukifune morning and evening, loving her without limit.

units.source_text: 常陆守出身并不微贱，他生于公卿之家，亲戚中也没有一个庸碌之人。

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi was by no means of humble birth; he had been born into a house of court nobles, and not one of his relatives was a mediocre person.

units.source_text: 家中财产十分富厚，因此生活相当骄奢，住的是华厦广宇，用的是锦衣玉食。

en.t: His household was extremely wealthy, so their way of life was quite extravagant: they lived in grand and spacious residences and enjoyed splendid clothing and fine food.

units.source_text: 只是在风雅方面有些缺憾，那性情异常粗暴，大有田舍翁习气。

en.t: Only in matters of elegance was there something lacking, for his temperament was unusually rough and had much of the manner of an old countryman.

units.source_text: 大约是从小以来多年埋没在那远离京都的东国地方之故吧，惯说一口土话，声音含糊不清。

en.t: Perhaps because he had spent many years since childhood buried away in the eastern provinces far from Kyoto, he habitually spoke in a local dialect, and his voice was indistinct.

units.source_text: 他最怕豪门势家，对他们敬而远之。

en.t: He feared powerful aristocratic houses most of all, and kept a respectful distance from them.

units.source_text: 万事十全其美，只是缺乏雅趣，不谙琴笛之道而十分擅长弓箭。

en.t: In every other respect things were nearly perfect, but he lacked refined taste, knew nothing of the arts of koto and flute, and was highly skilled with bow and arrow.

units.source_text: 这原不过是普通地方官人家，但因财力雄厚，所以优秀的青年女子都集中到他家来当侍女。

en.t: This was originally no more than the household of an ordinary provincial official, but because its wealth was so great, talented young women all gathered there to serve as attendants.

units.source_text: 她们的装束非常华丽，有时合唱几个简易的歌曲，有时讲些故事，有时通夜不眠地守庚申，做的都是粗浅庸俗的游戏。

en.t: Their dress was extremely splendid; sometimes they sang a few simple songs together, sometimes they told stories, and sometimes they stayed awake all night for the Koshin vigil, but all their amusements were shallow and vulgar.
